According to the header comment in `src/cli/lib/agentLoop.ts`, the agent can **only claim completion via the `finish` action**.

This is stated explicitly in the honesty contract section:

> "the SAME honesty contract as the manager: a tool reports what it really did, and the agent can only claim completion via the `finish` action"

The protocol further clarifies this: "every agent turn is a STRICT JSON object — either a tool call `{"tool":..., "args":{...}}` or a completion `{"finish":"summary"}`."
